question: Find the display names of users from New York who have earned both 'Teacher' and 'Supporter' badges and own at least one post that has no comments.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
WHERE u."XCL_058" = 'New York'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM badges AS b
    WHERE b."XCL_002" = u."XCL_052"
      AND b."XCL_003" IN ('Teacher', 'Supporter')
    GROUP BY b."XCL_002"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b."XCL_003") = 2
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c
        WHERE c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
      )
  )
